audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Kennen four of seven rows (Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Kennen, Kennen) while the prose in the same file describes Karma out-ranging and perma-shoving him, and the mirror audit (karma__kennen) locked the chart to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Kennen, Karma, Skill.
audit.why: Karma has 950-range Inner Flame and Mantra from level 1 with no skill point; Kennen's only gap-closer is Lightning Rush at 170 range and his stun needs three Marks of the Storm. The one row he owns is Level 6, where Slicing Maelstrom (120s) arrives and Karma gains nothing.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Kennen, Karma, Skill in both layers, matching the mirror; phases[N].why and whys[N] rewritten on the rows that flipped so the prose no longer argues the opposite.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Karma's takeover window in phases[4].why, whys[4] and spikes[2].text.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 and costs no skill point, so Karma has no level-6 spike at all. Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom (120s, 550 range) is the single largest swing in the lane.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as Kennen's spike with the 120s cooldown and the 550 range; first-item row restated as Karma's (Liandry's/Seraph's sharpening Mantra burst and shields).
sources: champ-data/_kits/karma.json (R: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point')

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction rows spoke only of 'tracking Focused Resolve' without stating the two mechanics that decide the lane: Lightning Rush's 170 range versus her 675-range root, and that the stun needs three Marks before it exists.
audit.why: Kit files: Kennen E range 170, Karma W range 675 on a flat 12s cooldown, Kennen passive stuns only on the third ability hit.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why and whys[2] now state the 170-range problem and the root that meets it; the level-6 rows state the Flash-Maelstrom answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line anywhere, despite Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve healing Karma through extended trades.
audit.why: Karma's W Mantra bonus explicitly heals her and extends the root.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb added to the itemization row, conditioned on her Mantra-W heal.

audit.why: The packet flags wants.foe[1] 'Hold Focused Resolve' as a probable wrong ability name. It is not — Focused Resolve is Karma's real W.
audit.corrected: No change; false positive recorded in notes.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Karma out-ranges you: 950 Inner Flame plus a Mantra she owns at level 1 beats your lone Thundering Shuriken. Soak XP, don't trade.

edits.before: Mark management: third proc stuns — count to three. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Only the third Mark of the Storm stuns, and her Focused Resolve roots you off the stack on a flat 12-second cooldown.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your range.
edits.after: Lightning Rush reaches 170 units — go in only when she oversteps, or her root and Inspire speed walk her out for free.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: She ranks Q and chains Mantra-Inner Flame to perma-shove you under tower and tax plates. Farm what you can and wait for level 6 instead.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is your one spike she cannot match — Mantra was hers from level 1, so she gains nothing at 6. Flash-R her step-up.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Liandry's/Seraph's sharpens Mantra burst and shield value; you can't all-in through it, so take the roam instead.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Karma carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: It splits: she out-items the lane, your Maelstrom out-scales her once fights group. Take the teamfight, not the side duel.

edits.before: My cleanest early window: a second Q point plus Electrical Surge stacks two Marks, so if she oversteps a Soulflare I E-in and detonate the third for a stun-burst.
edits.after: Lightning Rush only reaches 170 units and her Focused Resolve roots me on the way in, so my two-Mark setup pays only if she oversteps into melee.

edits.before: Even my Slicing Maelstrom spike is wasted in lane — I can't farm her shove, so she keeps zoning and bleeding me with Inner Flame here.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is the one spike she can't answer — Mantra was hers from level 1, so 6 gives her nothing. Flash-R her step-up.

edits.before: Karma's takeover window — RQ Soulflare zoning plus the Mantra root and Inspire move speed lets her perma-shove and tax plates while my Slicing Maelstrom is no use farming a lane I can't reach her in.
edits.after: My only unmatched spike: Slicing Maelstrom on a 120-second cooldown, 550 range, while Karma gains nothing at 6 — Mantra was hers from level 1. Spend it on her step-up or a 2v2 dive, never on her shove.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn poke), then Shadowflame; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's, then Shadowflame; boots Merc's. Oblivion Orb if Mantra-W heals her.
